description: Cleanup policies delete old versions from repositories. A policy only ever acts on the repositories it lists.
title: Cleanup

items.description: A rule that deletes old versions of artifacts from the listed repositories.
items.title: Cleanup Policy

id.description: Unique id of this policy. Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores; the id is used in the API and on the maintenance page.
id.title: Id

enabled.description: Only enabled policies with a schedule run on their own. Manual runs work either way.
enabled.title: Enabled

repositories.description: Ids of the repositories this policy acts on. An empty list means the policy acts on nothing.
repositories.title: Repositories

scope.description: SNAPSHOTS: snapshot versions, never one newer than the newest release. RELEASES: release versions. MIRROR_CACHE: copies stored by a mirror since they are recorded; copies cached before that are never deleted.
scope.title: Scope

keepLatest.description: Keep the newest N versions of each artifact within the scope. Leave empty to set no count limit.
keepLatest.title: Keep latest

olderThanDays.description: Delete only versions last modified more than this many days ago. Leave empty to set no age limit.
olderThanDays.title: Older than days

notDownloadedForDays.description: Delete only versions that have not been downloaded for this many days. Without download records the file modification time is used. Most useful for MIRROR_CACHE.
notDownloadedForDays.title: Not downloaded for days

groupFilter.description: Regular expression that has to match the whole artifact path, for example net/onelitefeather/.*. Empty matches every artifact.
groupFilter.title: Group filter

schedule.description: manual, or a daily time HH:mm in the time zone of the server, for example 04:30.
schedule.title: Schedule

policies.description: The cleanup policies. Every policy is evaluated on its own.
policies.title: Policies
